name: TripDocket: Travel Documents
subtitle: Family files, ready offline
promotional_text: Keep your family's travel originals together. Check the files before departure, open them offline, and export a chosen set when you need another copy.
description:
Keep the originals for your next trip in one place. TripDocket organizes passports, insurance, tickets and bookings by trip and person, ready to open offline after import.

PREPARE BEFORE YOU GO
Import PDF, JPEG and PNG files from Files, or scan paper on a supported device. On-device text recognition offers editable suggestions. You choose the document type, person and any expiry date; check these against the original.

Search by title, person or type. Check all originals to read the complete saved files and verify their integrity. This checks local files, not visa rules, booking status or whether your documents are sufficient for travel. Open the originals too, including in Airplane Mode before departure.

START WITH FREE
Free includes one trip, two people and eight documents. Checking originals, viewing, editing, deleting, basic export and backup recovery remain available without Pro. These are current library limits, not a lifetime allowance.

ADD PRO WHEN YOU NEED MORE
TripDocket Pro is a one-time in-app purchase, with no subscription. It adds more trips, people and documents, batch import of up to 10 files with individual review, and expiry reminders you explicitly enable. See the current localized price on the purchase screen. Existing files remain accessible if Pro is no longer active.

All libraries, including Pro, are limited to 64 MiB of original files in total and 16 MiB per file. A backup selected for recovery must be no larger than 96 MiB. The interface calls these limits 64 MB, 16 MB and 96 MB. Pro is not unlimited storage.

YOUR DEVICE, YOUR COPIES
No TripDocket login is needed. Documents and text recognition are processed on the device, without a developer-operated document cloud. A device passcode is required; access uses Face ID, Touch ID or the passcode as available, with iOS file protection for the local library.

Export a selected packet or full backup to a destination you choose. Exports are readable, unencrypted copies and cannot be recalled. Restoring a backup replaces the entire receiving library; it does not merge it. Keep another backup before replacing a library or deleting the app. Restore Purchases recovers a license, not documents.

There is no collaborative cloud sync or shared editing. Family Sharing for Pro is not part of this offer. Apple device backups and destinations you choose may store copies outside the app.

REMINDERS YOU CONTROL
Pro reminders use expiry dates you confirm and generic notification text. They require notification permission; delivery depends on device settings. Editing a document or replacing the library clears the affected schedules, which you can set again. Reminders do not validate travel requirements.

The interface supports English and Russian, selected through iOS, with regional date and number formats.
